title: The successive coefficient sequence stays exact on flat-term sheaf complexes
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site small in the coefficient universe, $B$ a sheaf of commutative rings, and $t\in\Gamma(\mathcal C,B)$ such that multiplication by $t$ on $B$ is injective. Let $n>1$ and put $R_j=B/t^jB$ with projections $\pi_j:B\to R_j$ [def-pe-principal-power-ring-quotients]. Use sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], scalar restriction [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and unbounded cochain complexes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. There are canonical quotient ring maps $q_-:R_n\to R_{n-1}$ and $q_1:R_n\to R_1$ with $q_-\pi_n=\pi_{n-1}$ and $q_1\pi_n=\pi_1$. The local formulas
$$a(\pi_{n-1}(c))=\pi_n(tc),\qquad b(\pi_n(c))=\pi_1(c)$$
define morphisms for which
$$0\longrightarrow\operatorname{Res}_{q_-}R_{n-1}\xrightarrow{a}R_n\xrightarrow{b}\operatorname{Res}_{q_1}R_1\longrightarrow0$$
is short exact in $\operatorname{Mod}(R_n)$ and remains short exact after restriction to $B$.
For every unbounded cochain complex $P$ of $B$-modules whose terms are flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], put $C_j^i=R_j\otimes_B P^i$ with differential $1\otimes d_P^i$ and $R_j$ acting on the first factor. Tensoring $a,b$ with $1_P$ gives well-defined $R_n$-linear cochain maps
$$\alpha:\operatorname{Res}_{q_-}C_{n-1}\longrightarrow C_n,\qquad \beta:C_n\longrightarrow\operatorname{Res}_{q_1}C_1,$$
characterized on local pure tensors by
$$\alpha(\pi_{n-1}(c)\otimes p)=\pi_n(tc)\otimes p,\qquad \beta(\pi_n(c)\otimes p)=\pi_1(c)\otimes p.$$
They form a degreewise short exact sequence of $R_n$-complexes, also degreewise short exact after restriction to $B$. These assertions do not require points of the site, sectionwise flatness of $P^i(U)$, K-flatness of $P$, or any bound on its degrees.

source.place: Second paragraph: coefficient exact sequence before derived tensor; agent refinement to arbitrary small ringed sites and flat-term complexes. Stacks Tags 03DA (sites-modules-lemma-abelian), 03EK (sites-modules-section-tensor-product), 03ER (sites-modules-definition-flat, item (3)).
